#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `string` | **yes** | Whether to add credit, deduct credit or set the balance. One of `add`, `deduct`, `set`. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | **yes** | The amount in minor units. |
| `currency` | `string` | **yes** | The currency of the credit (ISO-4217 code). |
| `description` | `string` | no | A note recorded with the credit. |
| `credit_type` | `string` | no | Recorded on the movement (default general). When this or `reference` is sent, the reply also carries `movement` (its id, null if nothing moved), `credit_type` and `reference`. One of `general`, `referral_rewards`, `loyalty_credits`. |
| `reference` | `string` | no | Why the credit moved; recorded on the movement |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Updated promotional credit balance |
| `400` | Invalid body / insufficient balance |
| `404` | No such customer |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/promotional_credits" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "action": "add",
    "amount_minor": 2900,
    "currency": "USD",
    "description": "Everything a growing team needs."
  }'
```
